capture.inputActuation: physical touch on the iPad Safari Trigger pad
capture.triggerMarker: first visible Safari trigger-count transition synchronously produced by the touch pointerdown handler
capture.acousticOnset: first sustained 110 Hz slow-motion spectral onset corresponding to the Lab 880 Hz probe tone, backtracked from one of 500 independently detected high-amplitude tone regions
capture.calibrationBasis: conservative 60 Hz display refresh interval plus one 240 fps capture frame; applied after clipping negative same-frame marker/onset ordering to zero
